input.summary: Insert new Section 5.5 vesting ownership of the Site deliverables, Content and Site customer data in the Company, with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and granting a licence-back, and no joint ownership.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on intellectual property, so we have added a short ownership section confirming that we own the Content, the Deerskin Marks, the Site materials developed for us and all customer and order data generated through the Site, with no assignment of our IP or data to HDI and no joint ownership. HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and gives us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything of its embedded in the Site; if HDI prefers, we can instead leave ownership of the underlying build with HDI provided we receive that perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site deliverables.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Content, the Marks and all other materials furnished by the Company, (ii) the Site, including its design, look and feel, and all work product, deliverables and materials developed by or for HDI specifically for the Site, and (iii) all customer, order and e-mail list data generated through the Site in respect of Deerskin Products, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in the items described in clauses (ii) and (iii). HDI retains all right, title and interest in its pre-existing software, tools, systems and hosting platform, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials to the extent incorporated in, or necessary for the operation of, the Site. Nothing in this Agreement assigns to HDI, or creates any joint ownership in, any intellectual property, Content or data of the Company.
